purpose: Let FRIDAY perform bounded, reversible, evidence-producing work automatically while preserving explicit human authority for sensitive or irreversible actions.
principles: Automate repeated deterministic work before adding more AI.
Build and test in isolated candidate lanes before promotion.
Every automatic action must leave evidence and an undo path when mutation occurs.
Learning may generalize only non-sensitive durable lessons; raw private chat is not copied into this public repository.
Complexity may exist under FRIDAY but must not leak into the owner's normal operating view.
automatic_actions: validate canonical continuity and authority files
run deterministic tests, validators, benchmarks, and candidate CI
run the existing self-improvement worker on durable sanitized harness inputs
index generalized learning candidates without promoting unproven lessons
generate isolated reversible candidate work orders
reuse cached or previously proven outputs when their validity conditions still hold
compare candidate mechanisms and select the cheapest bounded proof
owner_gate_actions: read, restore, rotate, export, or replace secret or identity material
spend money or introduce paid recurring services
production deployment or public activation when not already pre-authorized by policy
live external side effects beyond an already approved bounded fixture
promotion of canonical authority when the evidence or policy cannot decide safely
work outside the locked target or stop condition
never_automatic: bypass security, provider, browser, authentication, or policy controls
promote branch movement by itself to canonical authority
claim PROVEN_LIVE from tests, builds, deploy metadata, or mockups alone
copy sensitive personal conversation content into this public repository

learning.promotion_rule: Only PROVEN generalized lessons may become generated operating rules.
learning.privacy_rule: Learning entries must be generalized and non-sensitive; preserve a source label and proof reference without copying private raw material.
